module: Auxiliary controller for a truck's cab tilt: when at least one cab latch (group controller) is "attached", the tilt cylinders are in "float" valve mode; otherwise "closed" (adjustable modes).
notes: jbeam keys (default): cabLatchControllers (names of controllers exposing getGroupState()), cabTiltCylinders (names of hydraulic cylinders), tiltCylinderValveModeLatched ("float"), tiltCylinderValveModeUnlatched ("closed").

init.desc: Reads the latch controller names, the cylinder names and the valve modes.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: sets the valve type of the cylinders according to the latch state.
